items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-01-27
items.q: All them fellas like the old man, you know, Robichaud and Piron and all them fellas, you know, they had great big bands.

ctx.x: Would you say that New Orleans' music today is the same as it used to be fifty years ago? Well, I'll tell you.

It had quite a change there, you know what I mean? But you see, I'll tell you, years ago when this jazz came down, a lot of fellas didn't play this kind of music. A lot of fellas had big bands, you know. They had big bands. They had big twelve, fourteen piece bands, you see? All them fellas like the old man, you know, Robichaud and Piron and all them fellas, you know, they had great big bands. But this only last year, some of these fellas started playing this kind of music, you know what I mean? But they never…
They really tried to, I mean. They tried to, you know what I mean. How do you keep your band together? Well, I tell you.
